Composition & Indication

Furosemide 40mg — 20 Tablets (Generic for Lasix®) contains Furosemide 40 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 20 Tablets at the official 40mg strength. The standard indication is the management of fluid retention (edema) and high blood pressure, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Furosemide 40mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
